vulnerability_type: Liquidity Fee Not Added to Pair

preconditions.description: taxStatus must be enabled (true) via setTax function
Attacker needs BNB to swap for tokens through the Uniswap pair
Attacker must NOT be excluded from fees (excludeFee[attacker] == false)
Uniswap V2 pair must exist and have liquidity

exploit_hint: 1. Call setTax(true) as owner to enable taxation. 2. Ensure attacker address is not in excludeFee mapping. 3. Swap BNB for LuffyInu tokens via uniswapV2Router.swapExactETHForTokensSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens(). 4. During the buy transaction (sender == uniswapV2Pair), the liquidityBuyFee (1%) is calculated but NOT transferred to the pair - it's only subtracted from the amount. 5. Verify that the liquidity fee tokens are lost (not added to pair reserves) by checking the pair's token balance remains unchanged for the liquidity fee portion. This breaks the intended liquidity accumulation mechanism.
